en.intro: MSc in Advanced Computer Science at the University of Leeds, 2025–2026. In 2026 I had five first-author papers accepted: one each at PRICAI, ACML and NLPCC, all three as oral presentations, and two at EMNLP workshops. Two more are under review, both in Phase 2.
